hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.description: A few useful answers before you get started.

questions.question: What products does Velora Pleats offer?
questions.answer: Velora Pleats showcases Balcony Pleats, Window Pleats, Window Screens and Pleated Mesh Doors.

questions.question: How do I request a quotation?
questions.answer: Use the enquiry form on this website or contact our team by phone or WhatsApp. Share your city, product requirement and approximate opening measurements if available.

questions.question: Do you provide measurement and installation?
questions.answer: Please contact our team to confirm measurement and installation availability for your location and project.

questions.question: Can I choose a frame finish or configuration?
questions.answer: Available finishes and configurations depend on the product. Share your requirements with our team for current options.

questions.question: How do I maintain the mesh?
questions.answer: Follow the care guidance supplied with your selected product. Avoid harsh chemicals or forceful handling unless the product instructions specifically allow them.

seo.title: Privacy Policy | Velora Pleats
seo.description: How Velora Pleats handles information shared through enquiries.

sections.heading: Information you provide
paragraphs: When you contact Velora Pleats or submit an enquiry, you may provide your name, phone number, city, product interest and project details. This information should be used to respond to your enquiry and provide relevant service information.

sections.heading: How information is used
paragraphs: Enquiry information may be used to contact you, understand your requirements, prepare quotations and coordinate follow-up. Do not submit sensitive personal information through the website.

sections.heading: Third-party services
paragraphs: The website may link to services such as WhatsApp, email and analytics providers. Their own privacy terms apply when you use those services.
